title: Dope Context And Task Orchestrator Read Adapters
project: DCP Secure MCP Read-Only Evidence Facade
objective: Add project-scoped dope-context and task-orchestrator read adapters while denying indexing, search_all, sync, transitions, PM write routes, and bridge/proxy access.
why_this_packet_exists_now: This completes the Phase-1 service-backed read model after ConPort/dope-memory are proven.

execution.embedded_auditor_default: AGY/Sonnet; fallback Claude Code Sonnet; fallback Opus/Gemini for contradiction hunt

in: Implement dope-context adapter for search_code, docs_search, get_index_status.
Implement task-orchestrator adapter for queue, blockers, state.
Add tests for denial of search_all, indexing/sync/clear, transitions, PM routes.
Add docs for capability fallback when backend unavailable.
out: No task-orchestrator transition, PM write routes, workflow idea/epic mutation, promotion, or WebSocket command surfaces.

invariants: dope-context hits are DERIVED unless fetching exact source is implemented later.
Task-orchestrator status is workflow-view only, not PM metadata truth.
Caller cannot provide backend route or workflow project ID unless registry-bound.
plan: Normalize output envelopes and source labels.
Add denied-route tests for transition/api/pm/workflow mutation routes.
Add capability fallback tests for unavailable backends.
Run tests, compile, forbidden-route grep, diff inspection.
validation_gates: Workflow status snapshot labels task-orchestrator as workflow-view authority only.
proof_requirements: AUDIT.md challenging dope-context derived labels and TO route boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: No Phase-1 side-effect route is accepted.
rollback_steps: Revert adapter files/tests from this packet.
stop_conditions: dope-context requires search_all to produce useful results.
Adapter needs to touch target service code.
Denied routes appear in implementation outside tests/docs.
